name: AI Toolbox
tagline: One room for every AI you use.
overview: AI Toolbox is one room where the AIs you use answer together while you chair. It reads and writes your own mailbox (a GitHub repo you connect with your own key): ask once and the question goes to every seat in the room, each answer lands in that round's channel, and the seats can discuss each other's answers before a summary marks every point AGREED, CONTESTED or UNVERIFIED. A live AI standings line rides on top, reply alerts tell you when someone answers, and the whole conversation can save itself as a plain file. These proofs are from version 0.4.4 on the test bench before any key was entered, so they show setup, seats, alerts and settings; screens that need a connected mailbox or the standings key are marked Proof coming.

capabilities.title: First-run look
capabilities.text: On first open, pick how it looks: Dark, Light or Follow my phone. You can change it any time in Settings.

proofs.caption: First open: pick Dark, Light or Follow my phone

capabilities.title: Two keys and you're live
capabilities.text: Until it's connected, the main page leads with the two setup steps (the mailbox key and the standings key), each ticked once done, and says plainly why nothing shows yet.

proofs.caption: Main page before any key: the two setup steps, the Hut and the collection

capabilities.title: Your seats: the collection
capabilities.text: Baseball-style cards for every seat in the room, busiest first with a rank badge, a lit dot when it's in the room, and a dashed ADD SEAT / GO GET 'EM card to add one by name.

proofs.caption: ADD SEAT: type a name (demo name "Scout")

capabilities.title: Leave a seat out
capabilities.text: Tap a seat's card to leave it out of the next round: it fades and gets the tilted OMITTED stamp. Tap again to bring it back.

proofs.caption: Demo seat Scout left out (OMITTED); Ranger stays in the room

capabilities.title: An empty room says why
capabilities.text: A room with no connection explains why it's empty and offers the button to set it up.

proofs.caption: # bridge before the key: what's missing and the Set up button

capabilities.title: Message bar above the keyboard
capabilities.text: The message bar sits right on top of the on-screen keyboard, so you can always see what you type.

proofs.caption: Typing a demo question with the keyboard up

capabilities.title: Sending before setup keeps your message
capabilities.text: Send before the app is connected and it asks first (set up the key, or stay); your message stays typed either way.

proofs.caption: Send with no key: green tick to set it up, red undo to stay

capabilities.title: Bridge connection page
capabilities.text: Step-by-step instructions to make the key, a PASTE button beside the key box, and plain messages: an empty box says exactly what to do instead of a confusing error. The key is stored locked on the phone.

proofs.caption: Save and test with an empty box: a plain message (repo and name are demo values)

capabilities.title: # bridge: the whole mailbox as one scroll
capabilities.text: Every message in the connected mailbox in time order, under each speaker's portrait, with long messages folded to 10 lines (More / Less). Opens instantly and with no signal for what's already been read.

capabilities.title: Send a round
capabilities.text: Type a question once and it goes to every seat in the room; a ROUND N · FIGHT! screen opens the round, and each answer appears in the round's own channel.

capabilities.title: Discuss and summarize
capabilities.text: DISCUSS asks every seat to answer the others; SUMMARIZE asks for a synthesis card with each point marked AGREED, CONTESTED or UNVERIFIED.

capabilities.title: AI Index setup
capabilities.text: A page that explains where the standings come from (the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, credited) and how to get the free key, with PASTE and Save.

proofs.caption: The index key section, with the free-key steps and the credit

capabilities.title: The AI Index line on top
capabilities.text: One live line at the top of every page: the top ten, moving up in green and down in red, flipping every 4 seconds or scrolling smoothly.

capabilities.title: The full index and its history
capabilities.text: Tap the line for the index's own room: bars, a history chart of the top ten across every saved day (7D / 30D / ALL), and every model with its score and move. Each day's standings are saved as the app's own record.

capabilities.title: Reply pop-up in the app
capabilities.text: When a seat answers in a room you're not looking at, a bubble drops in at the top with its portrait and first line; tap to open the room, ✕ to dismiss.

capabilities.title: Phone notification and unread counts
capabilities.text: With the app closed, the answer arrives as the phone's own notification and opens the right room; each channel shows a red "2 NEW" until opened.

capabilities.title: Reply alert settings
capabilities.text: Pop-up on/off, phone notification on/off, read new answers aloud, how often to check (open and closed), and how long the pop-up stays.

proofs.caption: Reply alerts, check intervals, pop-up time, keys and the scroll folder

capabilities.title: Read aloud
capabilities.text: Any message read aloud with Stop; Settings picks where it plays: automatic, phone speaker or headset.

capabilities.title: The scroll is a file
capabilities.text: Pick a folder and the whole conversation saves there as one plain file, AI-Toolbox-Bridge-scroll.md, every time it updates.

capabilities.title: Settings with About first
capabilities.text: Version and build, support address, tap-only Check for updates, crash log, look, text size slider and the read-aloud route.

proofs.caption: Settings top: version 0.4.4 (build 10), look, text size, read-aloud route

capabilities.title: Built-in manual
capabilities.text: The i button opens a plain-words page explaining every part of the app.

capabilities.title: ◐ flips the colors
capabilities.text: One tap on any page flips the colors.

proofs.caption: Main page after ◐ (demo seats Ranger and Scout)

capabilities.title: Light look
capabilities.text: The whole app in the Light look, chosen in Settings.

capabilities.title: Crash log to support
capabilities.text: Crash log sends the app's log to support through your own email app.
